description: Permanently delete an attachment by id. Scope: `media:write`. Auto-snapshots first.

approval_id.description: Approval id returned by a previous call that needed approval. Re-pass the SAME args plus this id once an admin approves.

dry_run.description: If true, return what WOULD change without modifying anything. Nothing is persisted, snapshotted, or queued.

force.description: Proceed even if a pre-op snapshot could not be taken. Irreversible — use sparingly.

site.description: Site alias to target (e.g. "guns2ammo"). Omit when only one site is configured.

name: bridgistic_delete_media
title: Delete media
